name: Tapo RV30 Max Plus
summary: A budget robot vacuum and mop with a self-emptying dock that stands only 9 × 6.5 in on the floor, the smallest auto-empty dock in this guide. Independent tests found strong pickup on hard floors and accurate LiDAR maps, but weak obstacle detection and a basic mop.
idealFor: Studios and one-bedrooms with mostly hard floors
Tight budgets that still want a self-emptying dock
pros: Self-emptying dock with a 9 × 6.5 in footprint and a 3 L bag
Strong debris pickup on hardwood in Tom's Guide tests
Precise LiDAR maps, with up to four saved maps
cons: Weak obstacle detection: pick up cables and light objects first
Basic mop plate that can't lift over carpet
Picked up 68% of pet hair on carpet in Tom's Guide tests

trust.summary: Three independent hands-on reviews agree it cleans hard floors well and maps accurately, and none report a failure in common. TP-Link publishes measurable specs, a 1-year warranty with an RMA process, a US address and replacement parts. Safety scores 8/20: no CPSC recalls for the brand, but we could not verify a UL/ETL listing or FCC ID for this model, and materials aren't declared.

sources.title: Tom's Guide: TP-Link Tapo RV30 Max Plus review
sources.note: Christian de Looper, Feb 2025. Lab pickup on hardwood 98.6% Cheerios, 95.7% litter, 93.4% pet hair; on carpet 99.7%, 89%, 67.8%. Mop can't lift over carpet
